protocol.scope: CPU queue inference-only reuse; paired behavior and passive instrumentation; no general intelligence claim
notes: New independent protocol. Existing frozen cognitive-queue-v1 is not changed. Configurations match its first three seeds per split.
Each seed/condition runs disabled/enabled on separate ledgers; order alternates by seed. No concurrent workloads during measurement.
Disabled takes existing inference path. Enabled shares the agent-owned estimator with QueueForecast. Only infer is reused.
Fresh observations, Memory retrieval and receipt validation are retained; inference, retrieval and episode CPU/wall times exclude reporting.

Normalize random run/node/action/prediction/receipt IDs, timestamps, authorization expiry and latency. Validate original Gate evidence hashes and receipts first; compare all normalized predictions, evaluations, Gate decisions, observations and learning rows.
Raw ledgers/artifacts/semantic traces remain private. Report contains hashes, counters, timings and equality checks only.
Microbenchmarks include actual observation and receipt-backed retrieval, not just an artificial expensive pure function.
Three paired seeds per split, one sample each; instrumentation, disk/fsync and OS variance limit speed conclusions. No statistical performance guarantee.
Run one untimed four-tick episode per mode before paired measurements to avoid charging import/first-connection initialization to the first disabled sample.
